projects.name: CaseLens — AI Legal RAG Search
projects.description: Full-stack legal RAG system with double-layer guardrails, SSE streaming, and exact source citations.
projects.long_description: CaseLens is a full-stack Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system engineered for legal document intelligence. Built with Clean Architecture on FastAPI, it lets users upload legal files, case records, contracts, and jurisprudence, then query them in natural language and receive precise, citation-backed answers. Features double-layer guardrails that abort LLM calls on empty retrieval results (saving 100% of API costs on empty queries), legal-aware text chunking optimized for Spanish legal vocabulary, and a React + TypeScript dashboard with real-time SSE token streaming and smart citation previews.

metadata.challenges: Enforcing strict Clean Architecture boundaries between domain logic and infrastructure (LLM, vector store, parsers) while streaming citations and tokens in real time via SSE.
metadata.solutions: Designed a ports-and-adapters architecture isolating domain/use cases from FastAPI and storage adapters, added double-layer guardrails to cut unnecessary LLM calls, and implemented legal-aware chunking for Spanish-language documents.

highlights: Double-layer guardrails abort before the LLM when no relevant chunks are found — eliminates LLM cost on empty queries entirely
Legal-aware text chunking optimized for Spanish legal vocabulary and document structure
SSE streaming delivers citations before tokens start — sources visible immediately
API key security with dev proxy injection — keys never exposed to the browser

projects.name: WALTER-AI
projects.description: Multi-agent orchestration engine with clean architecture, strict tool-calling safety, and automated LLM-as-a-judge evaluation.
projects.long_description: An advanced multi-agent orchestrator acting as the backend engine for Walter's portfolio. Built with Python and FastAPI following Clean Architecture, it coordinates specialized agents using LiteLLM to dynamically query data. Includes a robust prompt-injection guardrail layer, real-time Server-Sent Events (SSE) chat streaming, and an automated CI/CD evaluation pipeline with an LLM-as-a-judge scoring system.

metadata.challenges: Ensuring strictly validated JSON responses from Llama models under tool-use constraints, preventing prompt-injection attacks, and avoiding provider rate limits during bulk automated runs.
metadata.solutions: Removed pseudo-code examples from prompts, built a regex-based bilingual guardrail layer, implemented exponential backoff logic, and built a double-layer CI/CD evaluator combining deterministic checks with an LLM-as-a-judge.

highlights: Supervisor orchestration with isolated tool access and structured outputs
SSE streaming with full execution tracing from prompt to final response
Automated CI/CD evaluation pipeline (GitHub Actions) combining deterministic action checks with LLM-as-a-judge
Proactive bilingual guardrail layer intercepting prompt injection, rule evasion, and formatting anomalies
Hexagonal architecture (ports and adapters) isolating router, LLM clients (LiteLLM), and audit telemetry
